question: In the 2009/2010 season, which home team won the most matches in leagues that featured at least one team with a 'Normal' build-up play dribbling class in 2014?

prediction.sql:
SELECT t."XCL_173"
FROM "Match" m
JOIN "Team" t ON m."XCL_013" = t."XCL_171"
WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2009/2010'
  AND m."XCL_015" > m."XCL_016"
  AND m."XCL_008" IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT l."XCL_003"
    FROM "League" l
    JOIN "Team" t2 ON t2."XCL_172" = l."XCL_004"
    JOIN "Team_Attributes" ta ON ta."XCL_177" = t2."XCL_171"
    WHERE ta."XCL_182" = 'Normal'
      AND SUBSTR(ta."XCL_178", 1, 4) = '2014'
  )
GROUP BY t."XCL_173"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
